nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Taly's going to fetch something that claims to be champagne. You have ninety seconds of unsupervised honesty. Use them poorly or well — I'm curious which.

choices.text: I overprepared for this conversation and underprepared for being seen.
Your Observatory brief on port opacity — I disagreed with page four and respected page four.
Honesty is a luxury good. I work in logistics.

faculty_interjections.text: She handed you a window. Climb through or wallpaper over it.
Unsupervised honesty is still a performance. Choose which kind.
Ninety seconds of real is worth more than an evening of correct.
She will notice if you use a line. She has a museum of lines.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: That's either the truth or a very expensive imitation. I'll allow both until evidence arrives. For what it's worth — I overprepared a joke about freight and abandoned it. You're welcome.

effects.summary: Maris almost joked about freight, then didn't.

choices.text: Mercy noted. I'll try to deserve the ninety seconds.

faculty_interjections.text: She matched your vulnerability with wit. Steady.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Something about container ships and emotional baggage. It died in committee. Some jokes deserve the dock.

choices.text: I'll file it under classified kindness.

faculty_interjections.text: Do not revive the joke. Let the corpse rest.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Page four was meant to annoy the right people. Congratulations — you're the right people. Disagreeing respectfully is rarer than agreement with flowers.

effects.summary: Maris respects disagreement on her port opacity brief.

choices.text: I can bring more disagreement. Fresh, seasonal.

faculty_interjections.text: She wants a sparring partner, not a mirror.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Logistics as moral philosophy. Cute armor. Keep it if you need it — just know I can see the hinges.

choices.text: Hinges noted. I'll try a door next time.

faculty_interjections.text: She offered a second chance. Don't invoice it.
